lithos_version: lithos 0.5.0 @ a4d2d62; return shapes cross-checked against the live tools/list surface (MCP serverInfo 3.2.0, 2026-10-04)

request.notes: Applies ONLY to an `open` task: a missing task and a task that is not open are answered with the SAME `task_not_found` code (one code for two facts — the write funnel re-reads the task to tell them apart). Releases every claim on the task. `agent` is the OPERATOR's id, not Lens's: every write auto-registers an unknown agent untyped, which is why the identity guard runs before the funnel calls this. `outcome` is persisted on the task row and forwarded in the `task.completed` event payload; Lens sends it on every completion (the default text names the operator, T3 D7). `cited_nodes` / `misleading_nodes` / `receipt_id` are accepted upstream and never sent — Lens has no node-feedback surface on this path. `task_id` accepts a full id OR an unambiguous >= 6-character prefix; Lens always sends a full id (the funnel acts on a task it has just read), so the prefix path and its `ambiguous_id_prefix` refusal are not on any Lens request for this tool.

errors.message: Task 'influx-gate-human' not found or not open.

observed_divergences: `unblocked` is a list of task IDS, not records — the payload names only the completed task, so a receipt naming the released tasks has to read them. The version pinned in `_tools_snapshot.json` BEFORE this slice described the return as "Dict with success boolean" and mentioned neither `unblocked` nor the resolved `task_id`/`title`/`updated_at`; the live surface (re-dumped in this slice) documents all four, which is what the payload above transcribes. The id also resolves from a >= 6-char prefix, so a caller that sent one could see `ambiguous_id_prefix` — Lens never sends one, so it is not listed above.
